protocol: leave-one-file-out, 7-of-6 hold 9, perturbation applied to raw counts before calibrate(raw, 'kalman_norm') and extract_features(); 'kalman' is the offline path as shipped, 'kalman_norm' adds F10
caveat: robustness to MODELLED sensor variation on one mounting; not cross-session generalisation, which needs Data/S1..S3 and --cv session
